—— 产品矩阵（三档按需升级）——
· 免费体检（/lc-free，¥0）：健康分+风险等级+最关键3条问题
· 标准版 v3（/lc，¥4.99/次）：15维度验收报告+修复工单
· 专业版 Pro（/lc-pro，¥14.99/次）：+金融/医疗/跨境合规库（GDPR·CCPA·HIPAA·等保）
同底座、同术语、同风险分级，结果页一键升级。
LaunchCheck — Check before you launch. Independent third-party AI quality inspector for your live website, mini-program, or app — runs system-level pre-launch checking and release audit covering website QA, mini-program testing, app launch self-check, bug & defect detection, compliance check, and quality acceptance. Produces a graded acceptance report + fix tickets. Call /lc with your URL/mini-program/code package to start. Pairs with PreCheck for end-to-end quality closure. ¥4.99/call, pay-as-you-go. Try it free first with LaunchCheck Free Checkup (/lc-free).

· Standard v3 (/lc, ¥4.99/call): 15-dimension report + fix tickets
· Pro (/lc-pro, ¥14.99/call): + finance/medical/cross-border compliance (GDPR·CCPA·HIPAA·MLPS)
Same engine, same terms, one-click upgrade from results.
